$comment: Marbles allowed restitution above 1.0 (energy-gaining bounces). Every other marble must keep physics.restitution <= 1.0; nothing here may exceed 1.5 (src/marbles/catalog-format.js BOUNCY_CAP_HARD_MAX). Add an entry only when bouncing IS the marble's identity, with the reason.

super_bouncy.reason: Named for it: the novelty marble whose whole point is gaining height on every bounce.

hyper_bouncing_prism.reason: Named for it: hyper-bounce prism; capped from the old 2.0 so it can't run away.

astral_jumper.reason: Low-gravity (0.4) jumper built around big floaty bounces; 1.5 was its original value.
